points.description: States that homogeneous coordinates are needed to give a uniform (single, consistent) matrix representation/form for the 2D transformations, i.e. rotation, translation and scaling are all expressed as matrix operations (3x3 matrices), so translation (which is additive) can also be done by matrix multiplication.
points.partial_credit: Half only if uniform matrix representation is stated but fewer than all three transformations (rotation, translation, scaling) are named or implied.

points.description: States that this uniform representation allows optimization (e.g. combining/concatenating transformations into one matrix) and makes calculation easier/more efficient for the computer.
points.partial_credit: Half only if just one of 'optimization' or 'easier computer calculation' is stated precisely.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the exact idea: homogeneous coordinates give a uniform matrix representation of rotation, translation and scaling (P1), and this allows optimization and easier computer calculation (P2). Vague answers such as 'to do transformations' or 'to make it simple' earn nothing. Wrong statements (e.g. that it is needed for 3D only or to change units) cost the point they concern.
